title: Full workspace design system, light cyan sidebar and CSS cleanup
scope: Unified the remaining workspaces, removed provably superseded CSS rules, replaced legacy charcoal states in shared components, and aligned the sidebar with the light white/cyan system. No production deployment or database mutation.
contract_test_summary: 181 contract tests passed for v68.26.0; see docs/design/CSS_FINAL_CLEANUP_v68.26.0.md.
full_flask_tests: not_run: Flask is not installed in the review environment; no live Flask session, database writes, PostgreSQL integration test, or production deployment.
backend_business_logic_changed: No route or authorization logic changed. The existing user-create route already requires and validates governorate_id for supervisor accounts; the missing form controls were added. UI text corrected to describe default vs additional permissions.

css_cleanup.method: Removed only CSS rules whose complete declaration sets were provably superseded by later declarations for the same selector and matching at-rule context; retained unique or uncertain rules. Changed a defined set of legacy charcoal color remnants to shared light/cyan theme tokens. Did not blindly remove all !important declarations.
css_cleanup.sidebar: light white/cyan surface with dark readable nav text and a low-glow active state
